name: Focus+Context Visualization via Deformation
definition: An interactive technique that magnifies regions with higher color gradient magnitudes and shrinks the rest of a high-resolution volume dataset to fit within its original volume boundary, allowing users to inspect selected features in context on low-resolution displays.
summary: Focus+Context Visualization via Deformation magnifies important volume features while shrinking less important regions to fit the original boundary, using gradient-based importance to provide continuous magnification without explicit feature specification.
